author: Nethersnow
body:
Hi there, you might of seen me on DTM lately. I'm LFT
I haven't been on for over 2 years so I'm very rusty, hoping to get better. Almost 14.
On almost every day, Time zone: Japan time
Bow skill: 7/10. Sword skill: 5-6/10 Not so good at PvP, but getting better.
Not so competitive, but if needed too will compete for the team.
Good at sneaking around and breaking Mons, but if needed to, can also defend.
I die a lot, trying not to. xD

Hope to find a team soon!
